note: One task instance, one artifact. The five shipped files are the cpcb-aqi-build-004 worker artifact a749f0df2f9dd0103d0ba56524e1cc3638242fbc4710b0cac99603bcdef0d959 (gate 1.5.0 on the full artifact, 45/45 checks, failed_checks empty, exact-byte --accept on the worker and re-accept in cpcb-aqi-baseline-001 before any score); the package's code/ carries the construction script, the references implementation, the runner-workdir materializer and the gate, baseline/ the runner-contract baseline. The holdout ships as an asset like the other splits; it is not copied into any runner workdir and was never evaluated. The prediction instant is 23:59 IST on day D: every shipped feature is the station's own PM2.5 history through day D (calendar-day convention, naive IST) plus calendar fields and station identity, and the D+1 label window lies entirely after the instant; row selection reads day-D completeness plus the D+1 observability rule, which never reads the label value, and excluded rows are counted per split. The label source (the D+1 daily mean) is excluded from every shipped column. The archive is ONE export (current_snapshot vintage, pinned), so the evaluation contract is retrospective research: no operational as-of claim is made, and intraday publication latency at CPCB is unmeasured (day-D trailing completeness at the instant is a declared assumption). MEASURED COMPARISON (the deciding check is part of the artifact's record, pre-registered before any score): the runner-contract baseline scored eval AUC 0.9734 (train.py and validate.py agree, on the accepted bytes after re-accept) on the identical 126,570 eval rows (2023), while the pre-registered triad members reached station_persistence 0.9689 and state_season_climatology 0.8617 (global_rate degenerate; station_train_rate 0.7616 supplementary; majority-class accuracy 0.8434); the model beats EVERY member - persistence by +0.0045 (station-clustered paired bootstrap CI [+0.0038, +0.0052]), climatology by +0.1118 (CI [+0.1002, +0.1252]), and its own AUC CI [0.9713, +0.9753] lies entirely above 0.5 for the degenerate member - so HEADROOM IS DEMONSTRATED under the pre-registered rule, on eval 2023 only; the holdout (2024) stays sealed and no holdout figure exists. The persistence-carried structure of the label is stated beside the number: the model's edge over persistence is real but small, and no figure may be quoted without the comparison. The artifact's splits: train 288,754 rows / 61,075 positives (21.15%) / 1,248 distinct positive days (2019-2022), eval 126,570 / 19,819 (15.66%) / 351 days (2023), holdout 145,124 / 18,222 (12.56%) / 352 days (2024, sealed); excluded and counted: thin day D 33,586/18,065/20,101, unlabelable D+1 17,416/9,368/10,879, outside-window 42,638, and the 2025-04..09 partial tail 47,566 station-days (829 valid-day positives); the 2025 hole months are asserted empty.
